title: Correct acceleration for S
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the centripetal acceleration of point S must be 4 m/s².

title: Correct acceleration for Q
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the centripetal acceleration of point Q must be 24 m/s².

title: No-slip belt condition
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the condition that the linear speeds of points P and Q are equal due to the belt.

title: Angular velocity relationship
description: Important: The solution must relate the angular velocities of the two wheels using their radii and the equal linear speed condition.

title: Centripetal acceleration formula
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the formula a = ω²r or a = v²/r for points on the same or different wheels.

title: Proportional reasoning for S
description: Optional: The solution may use proportional reasoning (a ∝ r for same ω) to find the acceleration of point S relative to point P.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The final answers should be presented with correct units (m/s²).

title: Confusing linear and angular speed
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assumes the angular speeds of the two wheels are equal.

title: Incorrect radius for point S
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the full wheel radius instead of (1/3)R for point S's centripetal acceleration calculation.
